inputs.name: ConnectGuardMiddleware.constructor.env
inputs.description: The partial relay environment retained by the guard. HARNESS_ENVIRONMENT selects whether the TLS gate applies, and HARNESS_RELAY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS supplies the comma- or whitespace-separated origin allow-list; omitted values are treated as empty strings.

inputs.name: ConnectGuardMiddleware.transport.request
inputs.description: The Fetch Request passed to the transport gate. Its URL protocol is checked only when HARNESS_ENVIRONMENT appears in relayConfig.tlsEnvironments.

inputs.name: ConnectGuardMiddleware.handle.request
inputs.description: The Fetch Request passed to the connect gate. It passes only with an Upgrade value of websocket, an absent or allowed Origin, and claims accepted by connectClaims.

outputs.name: ConnectGuardMiddleware.transport
outputs.description: The TLS gate response, or undefined when the request may continue. In a configured TLS environment it returns relayError(400, tls-required) for non-HTTPS URLs.

outputs.name: ConnectGuardMiddleware.handle
outputs.description: The first connect-gate rejection response, or undefined when all checks pass. Rejections cover a missing websocket upgrade, a disallowed present Origin, or claims rejected by connectClaims.
